author: Nick Pro
description:
I’ve been recreating stunts from movies on YouTube for over 8 years. I wish movie studios would see the benefit in working with creators. It’s unfortunate that when these videos get claimed, 100% of the revenue goes to the studio. Thousands of hours of work went into these videos. 🥲 Imagine growing up watching these movies, playing  these games, loving the characters, and this happens… 💔

Disclaimer: these claims come from Paramount only and not @SEGA_West or @SonictheHedgehog
title: Let’s tag @paramountpictures  an actual human can see this!💪
